classification.difficultyReason: Complete number lines spanning one whole, from 1 to 2, in sixths and eighths. Improper labels start at 6/6 or 8/8. It has fewer boxes and a shorter range than p9-q4.

answer.worked: Each interval is one sixth. The left endpoint is $1=\frac66$, so count sixths from there. Below the line, every label is $1$ whole with the leftover sixths.
Each interval is one eighth. The left endpoint is $1=\frac88$, so count eighths from there. Below the line, every label is $1$ whole with the leftover eighths.
